verdict.rationale: Bruno is an API client and testing tool, and spec linting is a fair axis for that category. However, the evidence pack documents no capability to lint OpenAPI or other API specs against configurable style or governance rules. The evidence covers collection runs, assertions, test reports, and AI-provider governance for Ultimate admins; that last item is adjacent and is not spec governance.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can lint API specs against configurable style and governance rules
